forum.content_text:
Hello,

I intend to use two 8-bit DDR3L memory devices with the STM32MP257FAK3. Could you kindly confirm whether this configuration is supported?

Looking forward for your response.

Regards,

Shubham

We are planning to use two 8-bit DDR3L memory devices, each with a capacity of 512MB.
